description: Sites the driver database may fetch from. Only approval_status 'approved' sources run. robots_snapshot_date is set by 'horn-sources robots', which stores a copy under data/sources/robots/. Rate limits are the minimum seconds between requests to one host; a longer robots Crawl-delay wins.

sources.name: loudspeakerdatabase.com
sources.approval_note: User asked for a very slow polite re-scrape (30 s between requests). Site was unhealthy on 2026-11-15 (HTTP 429) and 2026-11-17 (repeated pages). Check origin_is_healthy first; stop on two 429/403.
sources.status_note: 2026-11-17 13:55 UTC health check: robots.txt answered 200 (626 bytes, Cloudflare cache, unchanged). origin_is_healthy then requested / and the body passed a 5 MB cap within 0.8 s, so the check failed. Same failure as the 388 MB repeated-page response seen earlier on 2026-11-17. Pilot not run; no driver pages requested.
notes: No terms of use page found (About, Privacy, Cookie only).

sources.name: driver-base (open dataset, CC BY 4.0)
sources.approval_note: Dataset licensed CC BY 4.0: reuse allowed with attribution and a note of changes. One file, pinned to a commit. LICENSE-DATA names "the JSON files under `data/`"; the README names the published file: "**Dataset** (`web/drivers.json` and the schema/compilation it represents) ... [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](LICENSE-DATA) (CC BY 4.0)." The README also lists `web/` under the Apache License 2.0 for code; both licences allow reuse with attribution.
